_status: TEMPORARY prototype values, proposed 2026-11-24 and pending your approval. Shared by all camera nodes.

_notes.model_path: Relative to the camera_node folder. Your YOLOv8s-seg model (classes: fire, smoke).
_notes.device: auto = GPU if PyTorch sees one, otherwise CPU. Or set cuda:0 / cpu.
_notes.conf_threshold: Detections below this confidence are ignored. Tune using your validation results.
_notes.imgsz: null = use the size the model was trained with (640 for best.pt).
_notes.inference_fps: Maximum YOLO runs per second per camera (limits GPU load with 3 cameras).
_notes.preview_fps: Live preview images sent to the dashboard per second.
_notes.preview_width: Preview image width in pixels (smaller = less network).
_notes.jpeg_quality: Preview and snapshot JPEG quality (0 to 100).
_notes.event_min_interval_s: While fire stays visible, send at most one detection event per this many seconds.
_notes.heartbeat_interval_s: How often the node tells the server it is alive.
